facts.text: I feel that rituals and ceremonies in Paganism seem outdated and have no practical use in modern society.
I feel that these rituals are just superstitions and have no real impact on the world.
I question why people need rituals to feel connected to their heritage or the environment.
I still don't see how performing rituals and ceremonies can make any significant impact on society.
I think performing rituals and ceremonies is a waste of time and resources that could be better used for more practical purposes.
